requirements.normative_requirement: No backend, daemon, journal, attestation, or resource failure may fall back to unrestricted host execution.
requirements.primary_verification: Remove or kill each dependency and prove the tool call fails closed before any host effect.

requirements.normative_requirement: One user-scoped daemon coordinates all Pi clients, leases, reservations, retention, and recovery for the operator account.
requirements.primary_verification: Start simultaneous Pi sessions and prove one authoritative daemon/database controls admission.
